target_customer: Individual web users who want to change how websites look and work
problem: Websites have clutter and missing features, and writing userscripts is a barrier for ordinary users.
business_model: Freemium browser extension with paid plans for higher limits and advanced features
product_category: AI browser extension and userscript manager

founders.name: Jason Madeano
founders.background_notes: YC page: ML engineer on Homefeed relevance at Pinterest.

founders.name: Matt Stallone
founders.background_notes: YC page: led post-training of Granite foundation models at IBM Research.

competitors.name: Tampermonkey and Greasemonkey
competitors.what: Userscript managers that Tweeks positions itself as a successor to

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM generates userscripts with a script manager, selector and sharing; mostly application engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Easily copied by other extension builders; several similar tools appeared in 2025 and 2026.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Similar AI extension builders (Shaper, WebEdit AI, others) appeared later per search; no incumbent copy specific to Tweeks found.

market_need_then: Userscript managers had a long running user base; the Chrome Web Store listing shows about 10,000 users and the site claims 25k plus people.

branding.domain_note: Uses tweeks.io, not a .com; double e spelling of tweak.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful and conversational; uses tweek as a verb

branding.brand_signature: Tweek as a verb: you can tweek this page too
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Gigazine in November 2025 and discussed on Hacker News; a Chrome Web Store listing with a 5.0 rating per site.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable playful verb name with some press and Hacker News attention, but misspelling risk and small user base.

outcome_analysis: Tweeks started as a side project by two MIT graduates and went through YC in Winter 2025 under NextByte, launching in October 2025 per its changelog. Its user base is modest and the idea is easy to copy, and no exit or shutdown was found. Funding is unverified, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ lists a $500K pre-seed in March 2025 for NextByte at trynextbyte.com, which may be the founders' earlier company. The YC page says NextByte is an AI recruiting platform and the Tweeks site says Tweeks is built by NextByte, so the company history overlaps. Competitor entry has no dated source; later AI extension builders are not counted.
